supporting_pages.title: "Customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) \_|\_ Bigtable \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: If you want to control your encryption keys, then you can use customer-managed encryption keys (CMEKs) in Cloud KMS with CMEK-integrated services including Bigtable.
For more information about your encryption options, see Customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) .
Customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) By default, Bigtable encrypts customer content at rest.

supporting_pages.title: EncryptionInfo \_|\_ Bigtable \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: If this resource is protected with customer managed encryption, the in-use Cloud Key Management Service (Cloud KMS) key version is specified along with its status.
CUSTOMER MANAGED ENCRYPTION The data backing this resource is encrypted at rest with a key that is managed by the customer.
GOOGLE DEFAULT ENCRYPTION The data backing this resource is encrypted at rest with a key that is fully managed by Google.
